about_the_game:
CHAQS 44 is a system simulation experience designed for players who love exploring, experimenting, and breaking the rules of a digital world.

It presents a fully interactive desktop environment with realistic tools, terminal commands, apps, and dynamic systems that react to your actions—just like a real operating system.

Whether you enjoy solving technical problems, uncovering hidden mechanics, or simply manipulating a virtual machine to your liking, CHAQS 44 gives you the freedom to dive as deep as you want.

A World That Behaves Like a Real System

CHAQS 44 presents a fully simulated operating environment a desktop you can shape, break, rebuild, automate, or bend to your will.

Every file, every command, every window, every process—everything reacts with purpose.

The Terminal, Reimagined

At the heart of CHAQS lies a powerful command-line shell inspired by Unix philosophy.

With dozens of commands, utilities, and scripting capabilities, the terminal becomes your gateway to the system’s deeper layers.

Explore, manipulate, optimize, experiment and uncover what CHAQS is truly capable of.

Challenges Crafted for Curiosity

A series of challenges guide you into the hidden logic of CHAQS. Each challenge teaches, surprises, and demands clever thinking—not with handholding, but with meaningful, satisfying discovery.

A Runtime Compiler at Your Fingertips

Write and execute scripts directly within the environment.

Automate tasks, transform files, build tools, or create behaviors the system never originally had.

Your creativity becomes part of CHAQS.

An Ecosystem of Functional Programs

From the File Explorer to the embedded CEF browser, media players, widgets, and system tools—

every application is integrated with CHAQS and feels like a natural extension of the world.

Your System. Your Rules.

Customize wallpapers, effects, accessibility tools, shortcuts, taskbar items, layouts, and behaviors.

The more you interact, the more CHAQS adapts—subtly evolving with your usage.

CHAQS 44 is a playground for the curious, a toolkit for the inventive,

and a world for those who love the feeling of understanding a system from the inside.

Step in—and make CHAQS yours.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / Debian 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R7 240
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / Fedora 38
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA compatible
